integrity: An analytic proof and a reproducible finite-radius/series checker are embedded; numerical tests corroborate rather than prove asymptotics.
scientific_limitations: The boundary-gap parameters are fixed and positive; the sharp unique sign threshold is established only at intensity two. A zero limiting coefficient at the threshold makes no claim about the finite-radius covariance sign. Residual risk of an equivalent formulation in broader Gaussian zero-correlation literature remains.
title: A sharp sign transition for nested zero counts in the hyperbolic Gaussian analytic function
